text:
jay-android: Heads up — seeing duplicated POSTs from SDK on emulator when network flips (wifi->cell). Payload is small but server logs show two consecutive uploads.

maria-ux: hmm, which okhttp/retry settings? is retryOnConnectionFailure enabled?

jay-android: default OkHttpClient in our SDK. retryOnConnectionFailure = true. Also we have a ReplayRequestInterceptor that rewinds request body via `request.newBuilder().method(request.method(), createBodyStream())` — maybe that's the suspect.

ben-infra: interesting. On network change okhttp may retry only if it sees a connection problem during request; if body isn't repeatable, it should _not_ retry. Are you using streaming RequestBody?

jay-android: yeah, RequestBody that wraps InputStream. We added `throw new IOException("non-repeatable")` fallback but emulator seems to accept rewind. Repro steps:
```
1) Start emulator API 30
2) Run sample app
3) toggle airplane mode on during POST
```
Server logs:
```
2026-03-22T12:01:05Z POST /upload 200 id=abc
2026-03-22T12:01:06Z POST /upload 200 id=abc
```

maria-ux: can you paste okhttp client config? timeouts maybe low causing early retry?

jay-android: client:
```
new OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .connectTimeout(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  .readTimeout(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  .writeTimeout(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  .connectionPool(new ConnectionPool(5,5,TimeUnit.MINUTES))
  .build();
```

ben-infra: try setting retryOnConnectionFailure(false) as a quick check; and make body explicitly repeatable (buffer the bytes) or add `@Synchronized` to avoid parallel calls. Also test on physical device.

jay-android: good call — quick test with retryOff fixed it in emulator. We'll implement byte[] buffering as opt-in for small uploads. Filing SDK issue.

ci-bot: Issue #2345 created: 'duplicate-posts-on-network-flip-emulator' assigned to jay-android

maria-ux: thanks, add a note to release notes — devs could be surprised by duplicate side effects :grimacing:

jay-android: will do. PR incoming.
